title: Chief Product Officer
location: Abu Dhabi, UAE; Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

Bybit is evolving from a leading crypto exchange into a next-generation global financial platform — integrating trading, payments, wealth management, and institutional solutions into a unified ecosystem.
As we scale across products, markets, and regulatory environments, product becomes the core driver of user experience, growth, and monetization.
We are seeking a Chief Product Officer (CPO) to define and lead Bybit’s global product vision — combining product innovation, growth strategy, and AI-driven transformation to build a scalable, intelligent financial platform.
This role reports directly to the Founder and will play a critical role in shaping the company’s long-term direction.

What You Will Own

  • Own the end-to-end global product strategy across all business lines, including trading (spot, derivatives), payments, card, earn, wealth, institutional products etc.
  • Build and drive a cohesive product ecosystem, ensuring strong integration across all product verticals into a unified user experience
  • Own and scale the growth product function, including user acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization across global markets
  • Design and implement product-led growth strategies, leveraging data, experimentation, and lifecycle optimization
  • Drive AI adoption across products and internal product processes, including:
    • AI-powered trading tools, recommendations, and automation
    • Personalization and intelligent user journeys
    • Internal productivity tools for product and operations teams
  • Identify and lead innovation opportunities across both centralized and on-chain ecosystems, including AI, DeFi, and next-generation financial infrastructure
  • Lead and scale a global product organization, including product managers, growth product teams, and product operations
  • Translate business vision into clear product roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, and execution plans
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Compliance, and Business teams to deliver high-quality, scalable, and compliant products
  • Optimize product performance through data-driven decision-making, experimentation, and continuous iteration
  • Ensure product design aligns with global regulatory requirements and local market dynamics
  • Establish product governance, processes, and operating rhythms to support global scale and speed

What Success Looks Like

  • A unified, seamless product ecosystem across all business lines
  • Strong and sustained growth in key metrics, including user acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization
  • Clear product-led growth engine with measurable impact on revenue and user expansion
  • Successful integration of AI into core product experiences and internal product workflows
  • Launch and scaling of innovative product features that differentiate Bybit in global markets
  • High-performing product and growth organization with strong execution capability
  • Efficient and scalable collaboration between product, engineering, and business teams

What We are Looking for

  • Proven experience as a senior product leader in global, high-growth environments
  • Strong background in crypto, fintech, trading platforms, financial services or digital tech products
  • Demonstrated experience leading both product and growth functions, with strong understanding of product-led growth
  • Experience driving AI adoption in products or product organizations, with practical understanding of how AI enhances user experience and business performance
  • Deep understanding of trading systems, financial products, and user behavior in digital asset markets
  • Demonstrated ability to build and scale complex, multi-product platforms
  • Strong product intuition combined with data-driven decision-making
  • Experience operating in fast-paced, ambiguous, and highly competitive environments
  • Ability to balance long-term product vision with short-term execution priorities
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with experience working closely with founders and executive teams
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with high ownership and user-centric approach
  • Fluent in English; Mandarin Chinese is highly preferred

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
